items.title: Micron Just Hit a $700 Ceiling, Caught a Downgrade, and Is Down 10% Today. Is MU a Toxic Stock or a Prime Bargain?
items.summary: Micron brushed past $700 for a single day before an analyst slashed his target by more than half and the rally collapsed. With record earnings on one side and a looming wave of new chip capacity on the other, which story will the market believe?

items.title: Sandisk Stock Split Puts AI Memory Volatility Back In Focus
items.summary: Sandisk completed an 8-for-1 forward stock split through a Certificate of Amendment that also raised authorized common shares to 3.6 billion, while retaining 10,000,000 authorized preferred shares at a par value of US$0.01. The move gives Sandisk significantly more equity capacity to support long term AI driven data center demand, while the lower per share price can make employee options, retail participation and future capital raising structurally easier. items.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Stock Gets An AI Lift From Renewed Leadership Confidence
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has returned to his role, triggering a broad rally in AI stocks including Sandisk (NasdaqGS:SNDK). Investor focus has shifted back to AI infrastructure demand, with renewed attention on memory and storage suppliers tied to Nvidia's ecosystem. Sandisk is now more closely linked to expectations around Nvidia's AI rollout and related data center hardware spending. items.title: Sandisk Sinks 14% as Memory Stocks Give Back Nvidia’s Huang Rally
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSandisk fell 14% today, giving back most of Monday’s Nvidia rally, and Coherent fell with it. None of the three had news of its own: Nvidia slid on reports of an unconfirmed SEC probe.
